overall_description: Model Syringe as an industrial safety-first variant for heavy duty cycles. Start from a graduated barrel with linear plunger rod and nozzle tip, then add guards, lockouts, over-travel stops, and reinforcement at high-stress joints. Favor visible fastener logic and plate/brace load paths over decorative surfacing. Plunger motion should be linear, coaxial, and bounded by stop geometry. All subparts must remain connected to a parent support; no unsupported fragments. No floating parts.
